versos.hebraico: בְּ֭נִי אִם־עָרַ֣בְתָּ לְרֵעֶ֑ךָ תָּקַ֖עְתָּ לַזָּ֣ר כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃

controles.web: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger;
controles.kjv: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
controles.livre: Filho meu, se ficaste fiador por teu próximo, se deste tua garantia ao estranho;

versos.hebraico: נוֹקַ֥שְׁתָּ בְאִמְרֵי־פִ֑יךָ נִ֝לְכַּ֗דְתָּ בְּאִמְרֵי־פִֽיךָ׃

controles.web: You are trapped by the words of your mouth. You are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
controles.kjv: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
controles.livre: Se tu foste capturado pelas palavras de tua própria boca, e te prendeste pelas palavras de tua boca,

versos.hebraico: עֲשֵׂ֨ה זֹ֥את אֵפ֪וֹא׀ בְּנִ֡י וְֽהִנָּצֵ֗ל כִּ֘י בָ֤אתָ בְכַף־רֵעֶ֑ךָ לֵ֥ךְ הִ֝תְרַפֵּ֗ס וּרְהַ֥ב רֵעֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.
controles.kjv: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
controles.livre: Então faze isto agora, meu filho, e livra-te, pois caíste nas mãos de teu próximo; vai, humilha-te, e insiste exaustivamente ao teu próximo.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן שֵׁנָ֣ה לְעֵינֶ֑יךָ וּ֝תְנוּמָ֗ה לְעַפְעַפֶּֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
controles.kjv: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
controles.livre: Não dês sono aos teus olhos, nem cochilo às tuas pálpebras.

versos.hebraico: הִ֭נָּצֵל כִּצְבִ֣י מִיָּ֑ד וּ֝כְצִפּ֗וֹר מִיַּ֥ד יָקֽוּשׁ׃פ

controles.web: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
controles.kjv: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
controles.livre: Livra-te, como a corça do caçador, como o pássaro do caçador de aves.

versos.hebraico: לֵֽךְ־אֶל־נְמָלָ֥ה עָצֵ֑ל רְאֵ֖ה דְרָכֶ֣יהָ וַחֲכָֽם׃

controles.web: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
controles.kjv: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
controles.livre: Vai até a formiga, preguiçoso; olha para os caminhos dela, e sê sábio.

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֵֽין־לָ֥הּ קָצִ֗ין שֹׁטֵ֥ר וּמֹשֵֽׁל׃

controles.web: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
controles.kjv: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
controles.livre: Ela, mesmo não tendo chefe, nem fiscal, nem dominador,

versos.hebraico: תָּכִ֣ין בַּקַּ֣יִץ לַחְמָ֑הּ אָגְרָ֥ה בַ֝קָּצִ֗יר מַאֲכָלָֽהּ׃

controles.web: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
controles.kjv: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.
controles.livre: Prepara seu alimento no verão, na ceifa ajunta seu mantimento.

versos.hebraico: עַד־מָתַ֖י עָצֵ֥ל׀ תִּשְׁכָּ֑ב מָ֝תַ֗י תָּק֥וּם מִשְּׁנָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?
controles.kjv: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
controles.livre: Ó preguiçoso, até quando estarás deitado? Quando te levantarás de teu sono?

versos.hebraico: מְעַ֣ט שֵׁ֭נוֹת מְעַ֣ט תְּנוּמ֑וֹת מְעַ֓ט׀ חִבֻּ֖ק יָדַ֣יִם לִשְׁכָּֽב׃

controles.web: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
controles.kjv: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
controles.livre: Um pouco de sono, um pouco de cochilo; um pouco de descanso com as mãos cruzadas;

versos.hebraico: וּבָֽא־כִמְהַלֵּ֥ךְ רֵאשֶׁ֑ךָ וּ֝מַחְסֹֽרְךָ֗ כְּאִ֣ישׁ מָגֵֽן׃פ

controles.web: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
controles.kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
controles.livre: Assim a pobreza virá sobre ti como um assaltante; a necessidade chegará a ti como um homem armado.

versos.hebraico: אָדָ֣ם בְּ֭לִיַּעַל אִ֣ישׁ אָ֑וֶן ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ עִקְּשׁ֥וּת פֶּֽה׃

controles.web: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth;
controles.kjv: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
controles.livre: O homem mal, o homem injusto, anda com uma boca perversa.

versos.hebraico: קֹרֵ֣ץ בְּ֭עֵינָו מֹלֵ֣ל בְּרַגְלָ֑ו מֹ֝רֶ֗ה בְּאֶצְבְּעֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers;
controles.kjv: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
controles.livre: Ele acena com os olhos, fala com seus pés, aponta com seus dedos.

versos.hebraico: תַּֽהְפֻּכ֨וֹת׀ בְּלִבּ֗וֹ חֹרֵ֣שׁ רָ֣ע בְּכָל־עֵ֑ת מדנים יְשַׁלֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
controles.kjv: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
controles.livre: Perversidades há em seu coração; todo o tempo ele trama o mal; anda semeando brigas.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּ֗ן פִּ֭תְאֹם יָב֣וֹא אֵיד֑וֹ פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְאֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃פ

controles.web: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
controles.kjv: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
controles.livre: Por isso sua perdição virá repentinamente; subitamente ele será quebrado, e não haverá cura.

versos.hebraico: שֶׁשׁ־הֵ֭נָּה שָׂנֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝שֶׁ֗בַע תועבות נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

controles.web: There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
controles.kjv: These six things doth the Lord hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
controles.livre: Estas seis coisas o SENHOR odeia; e sete sua alma abomina:

versos.hebraico: עֵינַ֣יִם רָ֭מוֹת לְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר וְ֝יָדַ֗יִם שֹׁפְכ֥וֹת דָּם־נָקִֽי׃

controles.web: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood;
controles.kjv: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
controles.livre: Olhos arrogantes, língua mentirosa, e mãos que derramam sangue inocente;

versos.hebraico: לֵ֗ב חֹ֭רֵשׁ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָ֑וֶן רַגְלַ֥יִם מְ֝מַהֲר֗וֹת לָר֥וּץ לָֽרָעָה׃

controles.web: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,
controles.kjv: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
controles.livre: O coração que trama planos malignos, pés que se apressam a correr para o mal;

versos.hebraico: יָפִ֣יחַ כְּ֭זָבִים עֵ֣ד שָׁ֑קֶר וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥חַ מְ֝דָנִ֗ים בֵּ֣ין אַחִֽים׃פ

controles.web: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
controles.kjv: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
controles.livre: A falsa testemunha, que sopra mentiras; e o que semeia brigas entre irmãos.

versos.hebraico: נְצֹ֣ר בְּ֭נִי מִצְוַ֣ת אָבִ֑יךָ וְאַל־תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
controles.kjv: My son, keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
controles.livre: Filho meu, guarda o mandamento de teu pai; e não abandones a lei de tua mãe.

versos.hebraico: קָשְׁרֵ֣ם עַל־לִבְּךָ֣ תָמִ֑יד עָ֝נְדֵ֗ם עַל־גַּרְגְּרֹתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.
controles.kjv: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
controles.livre: Amarra-os continuamente em teu coração; e pendura-os ao teu pescoço.

versos.hebraico: בְּהִתְהַלֶּכְךָ֨׀ תַּנְחֶ֬ה אֹתָ֗ךְ בְּֽ֭שָׁכְבְּךָ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר עָלֶ֑יךָ וַ֝הֲקִיצ֗וֹתָ הִ֣יא תְשִׂיחֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
controles.kjv: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
controles.livre: Quando caminhares, isto te guiará; quando deitares, isto te guardará; quando acordares, isto falará contigo.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י נֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה וְת֣וֹרָה א֑וֹר וְדֶ֥רֶךְ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תּוֹכְח֥וֹת מוּסָֽר׃

controles.web: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,
controles.kjv: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
controles.livre: Porque o mandamento é uma lâmpada, e a lei é luz; e as repreensões para correção são o caminho da vida;

versos.hebraico: לִ֭שְׁמָרְךָ מֵאֵ֣שֶׁת רָ֑ע מֵֽ֝חֶלְקַ֗ת לָשׁ֥וֹן נָכְרִיָּֽה׃

controles.web: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
controles.kjv: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
controles.livre: Para te protegerem da mulher má, das lisonjas da língua da estranha.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תַּחְמֹ֣ד יָ֭פְיָהּ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְאַל־תִּ֝קָּֽחֲךָ֗ בְּעַפְעַפֶּֽיהָ׃

controles.web: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
controles.kjv: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
controles.livre: Não cobices a formosura dela em teu coração; nem te prenda em seus olhos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י בְעַד־אִשָּׁ֥ה זוֹנָ֗ה עַֽד־כִּכַּ֫ר לָ֥חֶם וְאֵ֥שֶׁת אִ֑ישׁ נֶ֖פֶשׁ יְקָרָ֣ה תָצֽוּד׃פ

controles.web: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
controles.kjv: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
controles.livre: Porque pela mulher prostituta chega-se a pedir um pedaço de pão; e a mulher de outro homem anda à caça de uma alma preciosa.

versos.hebraico: הֲיַחְתֶּ֤ה אִ֓ישׁ אֵ֬שׁ בְּחֵיק֑וֹ וּ֝בְגָדָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִשָּׂרַֽפְנָה׃

controles.web: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?
controles.kjv: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
controles.livre: Por acaso pode alguém botar fogo em seu peito, sem que suas roupas se queimem?

versos.hebraico: אִם־יְהַלֵּ֣ךְ אִ֭ישׁ עַל־הַגֶּחָלִ֑ים וְ֝רַגְלָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִכָּוֶֽינָה׃

controles.web: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?
controles.kjv: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
controles.livre: Ou alguém pode andar sobre as brasas, sem seus pés se arderem?

versos.hebraico: כֵּ֗ן הַ֭בָּא אֶל־אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑הוּ לֹ֥א יִ֝נָּקֶ֗ה כָּֽל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.
controles.kjv: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
controles.livre: Assim será aquele que se deitar com a mulher de seu próximo; não será considerado inocente todo aquele que a tocar.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־יָב֣וּזוּ לַ֭גַּנָּב כִּ֣י יִגְנ֑וֹב לְמַלֵּ֥א נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ כִּ֣י יִרְעָֽב׃

controles.web: Men don’t despise a thief, if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry:
controles.kjv: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
controles.livre: Não se despreza ao ladrão, quando furta para saciar sua alma, tendo fome;

versos.hebraico: וְ֭נִמְצָא יְשַׁלֵּ֣ם שִׁבְעָתָ֑יִם אֶת־כָּל־ה֖וֹן בֵּית֣וֹ יִתֵּֽן׃

controles.web: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.
controles.kjv: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
controles.livre: Mas, se for achado, ele pagará sete vezes mais; ele terá que dar todos os bens de sua casa.

versos.hebraico: נֹאֵ֣ף אִשָּׁ֣ה חֲסַר־לֵ֑ב מַֽשְׁחִ֥ית נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ ה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂנָּה׃

controles.web: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.
controles.kjv: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
controles.livre: Porém aquele que adultera com mulher alheia tem falta de entendimento; quem faz isso destrói sua própria alma.

versos.hebraico: נֶֽגַע־וְקָל֥וֹן יִמְצָ֑א וְ֝חֶרְפָּת֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִמָּחֶֽה׃

controles.web: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.
controles.kjv: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
controles.livre: Ele encontrará castigo e desgraça; e sua desonra nunca será apagada.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־קִנְאָ֥ה חֲמַת־גָּ֑בֶר וְלֹֽא־יַ֝חְמ֗וֹל בְּי֣וֹם נָקָֽם׃

controles.web: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.
controles.kjv: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
controles.livre: Porque ciúmes são a fúria do marido, e ele de maneira nenhuma terá misericórdia no dia da vingança.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־יִ֭שָּׂא פְּנֵ֣י כָל־כֹּ֑פֶר וְלֹֽא־יֹ֝אבֶ֗ה כִּ֣י תַרְבֶּה־שֹֽׁחַד׃פ

controles.web: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
controles.kjv: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
controles.livre: Ele não aceitará nenhum pagamento pela culpa; nem consentirá, ainda que aumentes os presentes.
